enhancements.description: `buildPrintVariables` now sends:; each value under its field id and its label only. The snake_case forms (`invoice_no`,; `products_table`) are no longer sent: the template service derives them for every key it; receives (`buildTemplateDataContext`), with the same normalization;; each table once per key, as JSON text holding only what the renderer reads: the column labels; (`printColumns`, or a saved record's `columns`) and one value list per column (`columnArrays`).; The rows keyed three ways, the 3–4 spellings of each column list, `columnKeyAliases`, selection; state and `summaryValues` are dropped (`slimTableForPrint`). It mirrors the renderer's; fallbacks: a table with no column labels, or whose labels match nothing, keeps its raw rows;; no `_metadata` (it is still read first, for date formatting).; The four standalone/preview print builders (FeaturePreviewInternal, FeaturePreviewStandalone,; FeaturePreviewStandaloneRoute, NavbarPreview) now use the shared builder, the same one PreviewPage; and the records list use, so they also get the form's date formats, lookups as text instead of; `[object Object]`, and slim tables. `buildInvoicePrintVariables` (ProductDetails/CustomDetails); keeps its own id/label/name aliases but drops the snake_case copies and slims tables.
enhancements.benefit: Ticket "PDF generate API payload & structure issues (94% duplicate data)". The captured; generate-pdf body was 1,939,825 bytes, 99.2% of it one 284-row table sent three times, each copy; carrying every cell 7 times (one batch code appeared 21 times). With production payload encryption; it was ~2.6 MB on the wire, built and base64-encoded on the main thread under a 30 s axios timeout.; Applies to generate-pdf, generate-docx and thermal print, which all take this builder's output.

enhancements.description: View PDF and Download PDF call master's new; `POST /master/feature-data/:featureId/data/:recordId/print-pdf` with; `{ templateId, versionSource: 'published', knownFingerprint, timeZone }`; (`printTemplateApi.printRecordPdf`). Master builds the print data this page used to build, so; the page no longer downloads the record or posts its data.; `printPdfCache` keeps the same slot, fingerprint and 204 handling. `PdfRequest.variables` is; replaced by `loadVariables()`, which is called only when there is no `featureId` or printing; by id fails (e.g. a master without the endpoint). It then builds and posts the data exactly; as before.; `PdfResult.fileReference` carries the record's part of the download name: master's; `X-Pdf-File-Reference`, or the browser's own `buildPdfFileReference` on the fallback.; `buildPdfFileName` is split into `buildPdfFileReference` + `pdfFileNameFromReference`, with; the same names as before.; `PrintPreviewModal`'s `pdfLoader` may return a `fileName`, used for its Download button.; Download Word still builds the data in the browser (`loadRecordPrintData`).
enhancements.benefit: Ticket "PDF generate API payload & structure issues": requests below 1 KB for saved; records, with no record download.

knownIssues: Because some menu structures have changed, certain features may return a 403 status code. To resolve this, edit the role, select the platform feature, and save the role again.
Use the conventional feature-wise approach wherever workflow scheduling is required.
Formula Builder UI – Field Insertion Through Typing
This works in current fields. For external feature fields, it won't work, as there could be fields with same names from multiple features.
Formula Builder – AI-Based Formula Writing/Editing Not Implemented
Organization Details → Basic Info: Website URL accepts invalid URL formats without validation.
Expected: Validate the URL format and show an error message for invalid values, such as www.example or example@123.www.example
Builder Tool Not Available on Mobile Web
The builder tool is not supported on mobile web. This is implemented as expected — builder functionality is restricted to desktop browsers by design. It should be available on Tab though.
Mobile – Formula Field Not Working in Tables & Charts
Formula fields are not evaluated correctly when used inside Tables and Charts on mobile. This is under review.
